description:
`mix ai.demo "your prompt"` — reads `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, calls `OctoPi.AI.stream/3` against claude-3-5-sonnet, prints text deltas inline as they arrive, prints a final usage summary.

Secondary flag `--tool` to include a trivial `weather` tool and verify the tool_call event path.

Purely to prove the stack end-to-end.
title: Demo Mix task: `mix ai.demo`
